description: This is a PHP source file defining the ReviewSearchController class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. The class extends AbstractVueController and manages the rendering of a review search component, setting default date range properties for the UI.

classes.name: ReviewSearchController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing review search UI components, particularly initializing date range properties for review search.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component before rendering, sets up the review-search component with default date props.

methods.name: addFromToDateProps
methods.description: Adds 'from-date' and 'to-date' properties to the component with default year-based range.
